notes: 'Behold here is' is kept whole on hinneh. The competing reading — 'here is' as a construction-supplied presentative frame joining the nominal anchor bitti under rule 20 — is named in the unit note and remains defensible; 'here' is a deictic answering to the particle's own force rather than an expletive like the 'there' of an existential, so the accepted reading is not clearly inferior and rule 2 retains it.
be'eneikhem fuses the preposition with its construct noun into one 'unto', headed on the construct (rule 30), the suffix keeping its own 'you'.
'any' is given to the construct devar as the word the ASV spends on it in this compressed rendering; the competing placement on the article is named in the unit note.
